description: R08 Host VT I/O checkpoint: close WriteConsoleOutputW through the safe-Rust CHAR_INFO serializer plus the cursor-preserving corked writer transaction exercised by Microsoft.

entries.notes: Safe Rust composes vt_char_info::write_infos with the DECSC/DECRC writer transaction and reproduces Microsoft's target origin, red/green and blue/green CHAR_INFO runs, exact SGR transitions, and cursor preservation byte-for-byte.
